actions.text: Dark theme. Switch the desktop color scheme between dark mode and light mode; night theme, black interface.
Night Light. Warm, yellowish screen colors that reduce blue light and eye strain; tired eyes, reading at night.
Do Not Disturb. Silence and hide notifications and alerts.
Volume. Turn the speaker sound up or down, louder or quieter, mute audio output.
Microphone mute. Mute or unmute the microphone input for calls.
Display brightness. Make the screen brighter or dimmer.
Keyboard backlight. Turn keyboard illumination on or off.
Wi-Fi. Turn the wireless network and internet connection on or off, join a network.
Bluetooth. Turn Bluetooth on or off, connect wireless headphones, earbuds, speakers and devices.
Airplane mode. Disable all wireless radios at once.
VPN. Connect or disconnect the virtual private network.
Power profile. Choose performance, balanced or power saver to extend battery life.
Lock screen. Lock the session so a password is needed.
Suspend. Put the computer to sleep.
Screenshot. Capture an image of a region or the full screen.
Screen recording. Start or stop recording a video of the screen.
Close window. Close the currently focused application window.
Floating window. Make the focused window float above the tiled layout.
Timer. Start a countdown timer for a number of minutes.
Room light. Turn the smart home room lamp or flashlight on or off.
